Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


This is from the Oct. 1, 1996 DCI tournament rules, found
at http://www.wizards.com/DCI/VTES_Rules.html

3. The Banned List: The following cards are banned from tournament play:

Cunctator Motion (V:TES)
High Stakes (V:TES)
Rowan Ring (Jyhad)
Stake (Jyhad)
Monocle of Clarity (Jyhad)
Playing For Keeps (Dark Sovereigns)

Some cards on the Banned List are not allowed because they clearly state
that they are only usable if playing for ante. Wagering ante is not
required in a Vampire: The Eternal Struggle tournament (see General Floor
Rules #2). Any future cards that make the same statement will
subsequently be banned. This list may be modified by the Director of the
DCI as necessary.
